scope: Exact-positive-zero incidence at six fixed pre-evaluation snapshots of ordinary E020 training reach. Counts include each listed fold CTA with its selected opponent row and payout.
limitations: No timing, dynamic all-iteration work share, kernel cost, speedup, complete-cycle headroom or fast-path correctness is established.

Raw reach float payloads are not retained: paired word equality, whole-array categories and reach fingerprints are native source-pinned assertions; compact row flags and fold incidence are independently decoded and recomputed here.
Row flag classes can overlap; individual category counts are not a partition of CTAs.
All-positive-zero incidence does not authorize skipping stores or imply positive-zero payout results; finite selected amount eligibility is reported separately.
Final full CPU q/scales are compared in native code and full fingerprints checked against immutable original/E020 anchors; raw full CPU payloads are not retained.
